items.headline: Grady Brosterhous throws for 242 yards and 2 TDs to help Utah State beat Troy 21-10
items.description: — Grady Brosterhous threw for 242 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for 89 yards as Utah State scored 14 unanswered points in the second half to beat Troy 21-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Roberts runs for 122 yards and a TD, No. 20 Missouri hangs on after a slow start to beat Troy 27-17
items.description: — Jamal Roberts ran for 128 yards and a touchdown, DaMarion Folkes returned a punt 68 yards for another score, and No. 20 Missouri shook off a slow start before holding on to beat Troy 27-17 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Jaheim Merriweather runs for 3 touchdowns and Troy defeats Alabama State 34-17
items.description: — Jaheim Merriweather ran for 127 yards and scored three times, leading Troy to a 34-17 victory over Alabama State on Saturday.
